_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Mukucheza Golf (Mchezo wa Khadi) - Mchezaji {player_id}.
Lengo: Pata alama ya chini kabisa katika mpigo huu mmoja. Ngati safu wamba zina thamani yomweyo, zinaongezwa kama 0.
Thamani za Khadi: A=1, 2-10=thamani yake, J/Q=10, K=0

Zochitika (tumia mabano enieni):
- '[draw]' - Chora kuwa sitaha
- '[take]' - Tola kuwa mphika wa zotchirikizwa
- '[swap X Y]' - Badilisha khadi yomwe yachorwa na nafasi X (safu) Y (safu wamba)
- '[discard]' - Chirikiza khadi yomwe yachorwa

board.drew:
Wachota: {card}
Lero, wamuyenera kuchita [swap X Y] kapena [discard] icho.
board.took:
Wachota: {card} kuchoka pa chikwama cha zotcheka
Wamuyenera kuchita [swap X Y] nacho (siungathe kuchitika).

options.final_turns: Magawo ya mwisho! Chaguo lako: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Mukwenera: [swap X Y] (kutondeka kutaya makadi mu m'phukutu la matayala)

message.deck_empty: M'thumba mulije kanthu! Maseŵera ghakumara nyengo yeneyiyo.
message.knocked: Mchezaji {pid} aligonga! Kila mchezaji mwingine anapata mzunguko mmoja zaidi.
message.final_round: Mchezaji {pid} {reason}! Mchezaji mwingine aliyeba atapata mpigo mmoja zaidi.

invalid.wrong_action: Tumia moja ya Bracketed action: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Munda wa vinthu vyambura kukhumbikwa ulije kanthu!
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Mungathe kuchirikiza khadi yomwe yapokwa kuwa kwenye mphika wa zotchirikizwa. Mungathe kubadilisha.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Muli ndi khadi yotcheka. Wamuyenera kuchita [swap X Y] kapena [discard] icho.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Kuti musinthe, mukwenera kuŵa na kadi ilo mwalemba.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Mukhumbikwa na khadi yomwe yachorwa kuchirikiza.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Mpando sikufika. Tumia mpando 1-{max_row}, ndi koloni 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Mungathe kukokota na khadi yomwe yachorwa. Maliza mpigo wako kwanza.
